params.Filmlook: The film character: Geen changes nothing, Levendig boosts saturation and contrast, Levendige huidtinten warms skin tones, Gedempt rood and Versterkt rood reduce or boost reds, Weelderig gebladerte boosts greens and blues, Warme aardtinten boosts orange and brown, and Glamour adds a soft glow with slightly muted colors.
params.Creatief filter: A color filter laid over the result: Nachteffect (dark blue and darker), Koeler, Warmer, Oranje, Champagne, Zonsondergang, or Aangepast to use your own filter color. Geen applies no filter.
params.Filterkleur: The filter color, only used when Creatief filter is set to Aangepast.
params.Dichtheid: How strongly the filter colors the image; 0 has no effect.
params.Luminantie behouden: When on, the brightness of each pixel is kept the same so the filter only changes the color; when off, the filter also darkens the image.

82e7.about: Simulates black and white infrared film: green areas such as foliage turn bright, blue skies turn dark, and bright areas can get a glow.

params.Sterkte: How strongly the infrared color mix replaces a normal grayscale conversion.
params.Gloed: How much bright areas glow and bleed into their surroundings.
params.Korrel: How much film grain is added.

80c3.about: Turns the image into a brownish sepia toned photo, like an old print.

params.Mate van veroudering: How old the photo looks; higher values give a stronger brown tone and less contrast.

82fe.about: Makes your photo look as if it was taken with an old photographic process.

params.Stijl: The process to imitate: Daguerreotypie (cool silver gray with vignette and grain), Albuminedruk (warm brown with vignette), Cyanotypie (blue print), Platinadruk (neutral warm gray with soft contrast), Vroege kleurenfoto (faded, warm, grainy colors), Box camera (contrasty black and white with soft, dark corners) or Cross processing (shifted, contrasty colors).
params.Intensiteit: How much of the effect is mixed with the original photo; 100 gives the full effect.

82e6.about: Converts the image to black and white as if shot on film through a colored lens filter, so you control which colors become light or dark.

params.Filterkleur: The color of the filter; colors similar to it turn lighter and opposite colors turn darker (an orange filter darkens blue skies).
params.Sterkte: How much the filter color affects the conversion; 0 gives a normal grayscale conversion.
params.Helderheid: Makes the result lighter (positive) or darker (negative).
params.Helderheid details: Increases local contrast so details and texture stand out more; 0 leaves it off.

8096.about: Wraps the image horizontally around a cylinder, stretching the middle and squeezing the left and right sides, or the reverse.

params.Sterkte (%): Positive values bulge the middle outward like a convex cylinder; negative values pinch it like a concave one; 0 changes nothing.

8097.about: Wraps the image vertically around a cylinder, stretching the middle and squeezing the top and bottom, or the reverse.

params.Sterkte (%): Positive values bulge the middle outward like a convex cylinder; negative values pinch it like a concave one; 0 changes nothing.

8098.about: Squeezes the whole image into an ellipse that fills the canvas, so a square image becomes a circle.

params.Randmodus: What appears where the distortion samples outside the image: Achtergrondkleur fills with the background color, Herhalen stretches the edge pixels, Transparant leaves those areas transparent and Omloop wraps the image around from the opposite side.

809c.about: Gives the image horizontal perspective by making one side shorter than the other, as if it is turned away from you.

params.Vervorming: Positive values shrink the right side, negative values shrink the left side; higher values give stronger perspective.
params.Randmodus: What appears where the distortion samples outside the image: Achtergrondkleur fills with the background color, Herhalen stretches the edge pixels, Transparant leaves those areas transparent and Omloop wraps the image around from the opposite side.

809d.about: Gives the image vertical perspective by making the top or bottom narrower, as if it is tilted away from you.

params.Vervorming: Positive values narrow the bottom, negative values narrow the top; higher values give stronger perspective.
params.Randmodus: What appears where the distortion samples outside the image: Achtergrondkleur fills with the background color, Herhalen stretches the edge pixels, Transparant leaves those areas transparent and Omloop wraps the image around from the opposite side.

809a.about: Slants the image sideways or up and down, turning rectangles into parallelograms.

params.Richting: Horizontaal shifts rows sideways, Verticaal shifts columns up and down.
params.Hoek: The skew angle in degrees; negative values slant the other way.
params.Randmodus: What appears where the distortion samples outside the image: Achtergrondkleur fills with the background color, Herhalen stretches the edge pixels, Transparant leaves those areas transparent and Omloop wraps the image around from the opposite side.

8189.about: Distorts the image as if it is printed on a ball, bulging the middle outward or pushing it inward.

params.Sterkte: Positive values bulge the center outward, negative values pinch it inward; 0 changes nothing.
params.Vorm: Cirkel uses a round area based on the shorter side of the image; Ellips stretches the area to fill the full width and height.

8099.about: Bends the whole image into a regular pentagon with one point facing up. Use it for badges, icons or playful frames.

params.Randmodus: Decides what fills the area outside the pentagon: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves it clear (the default), and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side of the image.

80aa.about: Turns the image into a grayscale charcoal drawing with crossing diagonal strokes, dark shading and grainy paper. Good for a rough, expressive sketch look.

params.Detail: Controls how strongly edges and shading are drawn; higher values give darker, more detailed lines.
params.Dekking: Blends the drawing with the original image; 100 shows only the charcoal drawing, lower values let more of the original photo show through.

80a6.about: Redraws the image as colored chalk on dark, grainy paper, with diagonal strokes where light areas get more chalk. Useful for a soft, textured pastel look.

params.Detail: Controls how much the strokes break up the chalk and how strongly edges are darkened; higher values give more texture and outline.
params.Dekking: Blends the chalk drawing with the original; 100 shows only the chalk version, lower values keep more of the original.

80a9.about: Redraws the image as a colored pencil drawing on white paper, with fine diagonal hatching and darkened outlines. Good for a light, hand drawn color sketch.

params.Detail: Controls the strength of the hatching variation and the outlines; higher values give more pronounced strokes and edges.
params.Dekking: Blends the pencil drawing with the original; 100 shows only the drawing, lower values let more of the original show.

80bc.about: Adds a painted texture of short diagonal brush strokes with visible bristles, lit like real paint relief. Use it to give a photo the feel of an oil or acrylic painting.

params.Zachtheid: Blurs the underlying image before the strokes are added; higher values give a softer, less detailed painting.
params.Haren: Number of bristle lines inside each stroke; higher values give finer, more streaky strokes.
params.Breedte: Width of each brush stroke; higher values give broader strokes.
params.Dekking: Strength of the lighting on the stroke relief; higher values make the strokes stand out more, 0 shows almost no texture.
params.Lengte: Length of each brush stroke; higher values give longer strokes.
params.Dichtheid: How many stroke positions actually get paint; higher values cover the image with more strokes.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from on the stroke relief, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Kleur: Color of the light that shines on the strokes; white keeps the original colors, other colors tint the highlights.

80c8.about: Turns the image into a pencil outline drawing: edges are traced in gray pencil lines on a plain paper color. Good for line art or coloring page style results.

params.Luminantie: Brightness of the paper; higher values make the background lighter.
params.Detail: Sensitivity of the edge detection; higher values pick up more and finer lines.
params.Dekking: Blends the drawing with the original; 100 shows only the pencil drawing, lower values keep more of the original.
params.Kleur: Color of the paper behind the pencil lines.

80a4.about: Turns the image into a black and white pencil sketch with outlines and diagonal hatching in the dark areas. Useful for a classic graphite drawing look.

params.Detail: Controls how strongly edges and hatching are drawn; higher values give more lines and darker shading.
params.Dekking: Blends the sketch with the original; 100 shows only the sketch, lower values let the original show through.

807d.about: Sharpens edges by increasing the difference between each pixel and its direct neighbors. Use it to make slightly soft details crisper.

807f.about: Detects all edges in every direction and shows them as bright lines on a dark background, with everything else turning black. Useful for outlines or as a base for further effects.

8082.about: Draws thin black contour lines on a white background wherever a color channel crosses the middle brightness level. Gives a simple traced outline of the main shapes.

82da.about: Keeps only the fine detail of the image on a neutral gray background, removing large areas of color and brightness. Often used with a blend mode such as Overlay to sharpen, or to inspect detail.

params.Straal: Size of the detail that is kept; small values keep only fine edges, larger values also keep bigger structures.
params.Kleur verwijderen: When on, the result is converted to gray so only brightness detail remains and no color fringes appear.

8080.about: Detects only horizontal edges (brightness changes from top to bottom) and shows them as light lines on black. Useful for finding horizontal structures.

808d.about: Spreads dark areas: each pixel takes the darkest color of its 3 by 3 neighborhood. Dark lines get thicker and small bright specks disappear.

808b.about: Spreads light areas: each pixel takes the brightest color of its 3 by 3 neighborhood. Bright areas grow and thin dark lines or specks disappear.

807e.about: A stronger version of Enhance Edges that pushes each pixel much further away from the average of its neighbors. Use it for strong sharpening, but watch for noise and halos.

8081.about: Detects only vertical edges (brightness changes from left to right) and shows them as light lines on black. Useful for finding vertical structures.

80ad.about: Takes a wedge of the image and mirrors it repeatedly around the center, creating a symmetrical kaleidoscope flower. Great for abstract patterns and backgrounds.

params.Horizontale verschuiving: Moves the point in the source image that the wedge is taken from to the left (negative) or right (positive).
params.Verticale verschuiving: Moves the point in the source image that the wedge is taken from up (negative) or down (positive).
params.Draaihoek: Rotates the wedge that is sampled from the image, in degrees, which changes which part of the image fills the petals.
params.Schaalfactor: Zooms the sampled area; higher values take in more of the image so details appear smaller, negative values zoom in.
params.Aantal bloembladen: Number of mirrored segments around the center; higher values give more, narrower petals.
params.Aantal banen: Number of extra rings from the center outward, each mirrored in turn; 0 gives one continuous ring.
params.Radiale zuiging: Pulls content from further out toward the center; higher values squeeze more of the image into the middle.
params.Randmodus: Decides what fills areas that sample outside the image: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves them clear, and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side.

80af.about: Repeats the image as a grid of mirrored copies, so neighboring tiles join seamlessly. Useful for making patterns and seamless backgrounds.

params.Horizontale verschuiving: Shifts the image horizontally inside each tile.
params.Verticale verschuiving: Shifts the image vertically inside each tile.
params.Draaihoek: Rotates the whole tile grid, in degrees.
params.Schaalfactor: Zooms the tiles; higher values make each tile larger, negative values make them smaller so more copies fit.
params.Aantal kolommen: Number of tiles across the width.
params.Aantal rijen: Number of tiles down the height.
params.Horizontale opschuiving (%): Slides the whole pattern left or right by a percentage of the image width.
params.Verticale opschuiving (%): Slides the whole pattern up or down by a percentage of the image height.

80b7.about: Mirrors one half of the image onto the other along a straight line, creating perfect symmetry. At 0 degrees the line is vertical and the left half is copied onto the right.

params.Horizontale verschuiving: Moves the mirror line to the left (negative) or right (positive) of the image center.
params.Verticale verschuiving: Moves the mirror line up (negative) or down (positive) from the image center.
params.Draaihoek: Rotates the mirror line, in degrees, so you can mirror horizontally or diagonally.
params.Randmodus: Decides what fills areas that sample outside the image: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves them clear, and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side.

80ac.about: Fills the image with ever smaller copies of itself nested toward a center point, like standing between two mirrors. Good for tunnel and feedback effects.

params.Dekking: Blends the nested copies with the original; 100 shows only the effect, lower values let the original show through.
params.Intensiteit: Higher values create more copies with each one shrinking more, giving a deeper tunnel.
params.Horizontale verschuiving (%): Horizontal position of the point the copies shrink toward, as a percentage of the width.
params.Verticale verschuiving (%): Vertical position of the point the copies shrink toward, as a percentage of the height.
params.Elliptisch: When on, the copies are nested in oval rings instead of rectangles.

80ca.about: Covers the image with fine, curving hair strands so it looks like fur. Useful for animal textures or soft fuzzy surfaces.

params.Vervaging: Blurs the image under the fur; higher values give smoother color areas.
params.Dichtheid: How many hairs are drawn; higher values give thicker fur.
params.Lengte: Length of each hair; higher values give longer, more flowing strands.
params.Transparantie: Blends the original image back over the fur; higher values make the fur fainter.

808c.about: Turns the image into a gray relief that looks pressed into metal or paper, with diagonal edges lit on one side and shaded on the other. All color is removed.

80ce.about: Adds a fine leather grain with lit, curving grooves over the image. Good for book covers, cases and other leather looking surfaces.

params.Lichtkleur: Color of the light shining on the texture; white keeps the original colors.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Vervaging: Blurs the underlying image before the grain is added.
params.Transparantie: How much image color stays visible inside the grooves; higher values make the grooves less dark.
params.Aantal groeven: Number of grooves; higher values give a denser, finer grain.
params.Lengte groeven: Stretches the grooves in one direction; higher values give longer, more elongated grooves.

80c1.about: Makes the image look like polished stone with marble like veins and shiny highlights. The image brightness is used as a soft relief.

params.Vervaging: Blurs the underlying image first; higher values give smoother stone.
params.Detail: How strongly the image itself shows up as relief; higher values give more pronounced shapes.
params.Polijsten: Smooths the relief and increases the gloss; higher values look more polished and shiny.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Kleur: Color of the light shining on the stone.

80a5.about: Overlays evenly spaced strips with a shaded gradient, like looking through window blinds. Useful for stylized lighting or striped textures.

params.Breedte: Width of each strip in pixels.
params.Dekking: How strongly the shading color covers the image; higher values give darker, more visible blinds.
params.Kleur: Color of the shading on the strips.
params.Horizontaal: When on, the strips run horizontally; when off, they are vertical.
params.Licht van links/boven: Flips the gradient inside each strip so the light seems to come from the left or top instead of the right or bottom.

80b9.about: Breaks the image into slightly irregular, beveled tiles with grout lines, like an old stone mosaic. Each tile mostly takes the average color of its area.

params.Aantal kolommen: Number of tiles across the width; higher values give smaller tiles.
params.Aantal rijen: Number of tiles down the height; ignored when Symmetric is on.
params.Symmetrisch: When on, tiles are square and their size follows the number of columns.
params.Tegeldiffusie: How much of the original detail remains inside each tile; 0 gives flat single color tiles, higher values show more of the image.
params.Voegbreedte: Width of the grout lines between tiles; 0 removes them.
params.Voegdekking: How much the dark grout color covers the image in the grout lines; lower values let the image show through.

80ba.about: Divides the image into square glass tiles, each acting like a small lens that magnifies and bends the part of the image behind it. Gives a glass block or glass mosaic look.

params.Aantal kolommen: Number of tiles across the width; higher values give smaller tiles.
params.Aantal rijen: Number of tiles down the height; ignored when Symmetric is on.
params.Symmetrisch: When on, tiles are square and their size follows the number of columns.
params.Glaskromming: How strongly each tile magnifies its content; higher values show a smaller part of the image per tile.
params.Randkromming: Extra distortion and shading near the tile edges; higher values give rounder, more three dimensional tiles.
params.Voegbreedte: Width of the lines between tiles; 0 removes them.
params.Voegdekking: How dark the lines between tiles are; higher values give darker grout.

80b4.about: Overlays a grid of raised tiles (triangles, squares or hexagons) with lit bevels and dark joints, while keeping the image colors. Good for tiled wall or mosaic looks.

params.Tegelvorm: Shape of the tiles: Triangle, Square or Hexagon.
params.Tegelgrootte: Size of each tile in pixels.
params.Randgrootte: Width of the black joints between tiles; 0 removes them.
params.Gladheid: Width of the sloping bevel at the tile edges; higher values give softer, rounder edges.
params.Diepte: Height of the relief; higher values make the bevels stand out more.
params.Omgevingslicht: Overall brightness of the light that falls everywhere; negative values darken, positive values brighten.
params.Glans: Strength of the shiny highlights on the bevels.
params.Kleur: Color of the light; white keeps the original colors.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Intensiteit: Strength of the directional light; higher values give stronger contrast between lit and shaded sides.
params.Hoogte: Elevation of the light above the image; low values give long, dramatic shading, 90 lights from straight above.

80cd.about: Replaces the image with a rough leather surface in your chosen color, with a coarse grain and the image shapes pressed into it as relief. Useful for embossed leather looks.

params.Lichtkleur: Color of the light shining on the leather.
params.Leerkleur: Base color of the leather; the image brightness varies it slightly.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Luminantie: Overall brightness; negative values darken the leather, positive values brighten it.
params.Contrast: Strength of the rough grain; higher values give a coarser surface.
params.Scherpte: How strongly the image shapes are pressed into the leather; higher values show more of the image.
params.Vervaging: Blurs the image before it is used as relief; higher values give softer shapes.

80b0.about: Replaces the image colors with a material pattern such as gold or marble and uses the image brightness as relief, so it looks carved out of that material.

params.Patroon: Material that covers the image. First the built-in materials (Gold, Marble, Wood, Granite, Copper, Jade), then all seamless patterns from Materials. If patterns from an existing installation or your own Patterns folder are found, they are listed at the end.
params.Grootte %: Scale of the material pattern; higher values give larger veins and grain.
params.Gladheid: Smooths the relief taken from the image; higher values give softer shapes.
params.Diepte: Height of the relief; higher values make the carving stand out more.
params.Omgevingslicht: Overall brightness of the light that falls everywhere; negative values darken, positive values brighten.
params.Glans: Strength of the shiny highlights on the relief.
params.Kleur: Color of the light; white keeps the material colors.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Intensiteit: Strength of the directional light; higher values give stronger lit and shaded sides.
params.Hoogte: Elevation of the light above the image; low values give stronger shading, 90 lights from straight above.

80cb.about: Covers the image with crossing strands of straw in two main directions, with a warm golden tint. Useful for rustic or woven textures.

params.Vervaging: Blurs the image under the straw; higher values give smoother color areas.
params.Dichtheid: How many straws are drawn; higher values cover the image more thickly.
params.Transparantie: Blends the original image back over the straw; higher values make the straw fainter.

80b1.about: Lights the image as if it has a surface texture such as stone, fabric, paper or bricks, while keeping its colors. Good for adding physical structure to flat images.

params.Textuur: The surface relief. First the built-in textures (Stone, Fabric, Paper, Noise, Bricks, Waves, Crumpled), then all seamless patterns from Materials, whose brightness becomes the relief. Patterns from an existing installation or your own Patterns folder are listed at the end.
params.Grootte %: Scale of the texture; higher values give larger structures.
params.Gladheid: Softens the texture; higher values give a smoother, less sharp surface.
params.Diepte: Height of the texture relief; higher values make it stand out more.
params.Omgevingslicht: Overall brightness of the light that falls everywhere; negative values darken, positive values brighten.
params.Glans: Strength of the shiny highlights on the texture; 0 gives a matte surface.
params.Kleur: Color of the light; white keeps the original colors.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Intensiteit: Strength of the directional light; higher values give stronger contrast in the texture.
params.Hoogte: Elevation of the light above the image; low values give stronger shading, 90 lights from straight above.

80a3.about: Turns the image into woven strands that cross over and under each other, with gaps in between. Useful for fabric, basket or canvas textures.

params.Tussenruimte: Width of the gaps between strands in pixels; 0 gives a closed weave.
params.Breedte: Width of each strand in pixels.
params.Dekking: How strongly the weave color and strand shading are applied; higher values give more visible, more tinted strands.
params.Weefkleur: Color the strands are tinted toward.
params.Kleur tussenruimte: Color used in the gaps between strands when Fill spacing is on.
params.Tussenruimte vullen: When on, the gaps are filled with the spacing color; when off, the original image shows in the gaps.

80c0.about: Makes the image look like soft, shiny molded plastic by simplifying it into rounded blobs with strong glossy highlights.

params.Vervaging: Blurs the image first; higher values give smoother, simpler shapes.
params.Detail: Higher values give finer and more pronounced shapes; lower values give softer, broader blobs.
params.Dichtheid: Number of brightness levels used to form the shapes; higher values give more, smaller blobs.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Kleur: Color of the light and highlights.

80be.about: Gives the image a grainy sandstone surface with fine speckles and horizontal layers, lit as relief. Good for rock and stone textures.

params.Vervaging: Blurs the image first; higher values give softer shapes.
params.Detail: How strongly the image shapes show up in the relief; higher values give more pronounced shapes.
params.Luminantie: Overall brightness; negative values darken, positive values brighten.
params.Hoek: Direction the light comes from, in degrees (0 is top, increasing clockwise).
params.Kleur: Color of the light shining on the stone.

80b6.about: Bulges a circular area of the image outward like a ball, or pushes it inward with negative strength. Useful for fun distortions or emphasizing a subject.

params.Horizontaal: Moves the center of the sphere left (negative) or right (positive) of the image center.
params.Verticaal: Moves the center of the sphere up (negative) or down (positive) from the image center.
params.Grootte (%): Size of the affected circle, as a percentage of half the larger image side.
params.Sterkte: Positive values magnify the middle of the circle, negative values pinch it inward; larger numbers give a stronger effect.

8093.about: Bends the image into sine waves, horizontally, vertically or both. Good for water, flag and wobble effects.

params.Horizontale amplitude: How far pixels are shifted left and right; 0 turns off the horizontal wave.
params.Horizontale golflengte: Distance between the horizontal wave crests; higher values give longer, gentler waves.
params.Verticale amplitude: How far pixels are shifted up and down; 0 turns off the vertical wave.
params.Verticale golflengte: Distance between the vertical wave crests; higher values give longer, gentler waves.
params.Randmodus: Decides what fills areas that sample outside the image: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves them clear, and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side.

8094.about: Squeezes the middle of the image toward the center, as if it is being pinched. Negative values do the opposite and bulge it outward.

params.Sterkte (%): Positive values pinch the center, negative values bulge it; larger numbers give a stronger distortion.

80ae.about: Twists the image into a grid of small swirls, one in the middle of each cell. Good for decorative, curly patterns.

params.Aantal kolommen: Number of swirl cells across the width.
params.Aantal rijen: Number of swirl cells down the height; ignored when Symmetric is on.
params.Symmetrisch: When on, the number of rows equals the number of columns.
params.Straal (%): Size of each swirl as a percentage of the cell size.
params.Sterkte: How much each swirl twists; higher values give tighter curls, up to about one and a half turns.
params.Met de klok mee: When on, the swirls turn clockwise; when off, counterclockwise.

818f.about: Simulates the distortion of a camera lens, such as barrel, fisheye or pincushion. Use it for creative wide angle looks.

params.Vervormingstype: Barrel compresses the edges, Fisheye simulates a wide angle lens, Fisheye (spherical) bulges a circle in the middle like a sphere, and Pincushion stretches the edges outward.
params.Sterkte / gezichtsveld: Strength of the distortion, or the field of view for fisheye; higher values distort more.
params.Horizontaal (%): Horizontal position of the lens center as a percentage of the width.
params.Verticaal (%): Vertical position of the lens center as a percentage of the height.
params.Randmodus: Decides what fills areas that sample outside the image: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves them clear, and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side.

808e.about: Divides the image into rectangular blocks and fills each block with its average color. Use it for a retro pixel look or to hide faces and details.

params.Blokbreedte: Width of each block in pixels.
params.Blokhoogte: Height of each block in pixels; ignored when Symmetric is on.
params.Symmetrisch: When on, blocks are square and use the block width for both sides.

8095.about: Pushes the middle of the image outward so it bulges toward you. Negative values do the opposite and pinch it inward.

params.Sterkte (%): Positive values bulge the center, negative values pinch it; larger numbers give a stronger distortion.

818a.about: Converts the image between rectangular and circular (polar) coordinates. Rectangular to polar wraps the image around the center, with the top edge becoming the center; polar to rectangular unrolls a circular image into a strip.

params.Omzetting: Rectangular to polar bends the image into a circle; Polar to rectangular unwraps a circle into a flat rectangle.
params.Randmodus: Decides what fills areas that sample outside the image: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves them clear, and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side.

8092.about: Adds concentric rings around a point, like ripples spreading on water after dropping a stone.

params.Horizontaal (%): Horizontal position of the ripple center as a percentage of the width.
params.Verticaal (%): Vertical position of the ripple center as a percentage of the height.
params.Amplitude: How far pixels are pushed in and out; higher values give stronger ripples.
params.Golflengte: Distance between the rings; higher values give wider, fewer ripples.
params.Randmodus: Decides what fills areas that sample outside the image: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves them clear, and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side.

8091.about: Twists the image around its center like a whirlpool. The twist is strongest in the middle and fades out toward the corners.

params.Graden: How far the center is rotated; positive values twist clockwise, negative values counterclockwise, and larger numbers give a tighter spiral.

80b8.about: Pushes the image in and out around a center point in a star like pattern, leaving a calm area in the middle. Good for halo, splash and sunburst shapes.

params.Horizontaal: Moves the center left (negative) or right (positive) of the image center.
params.Verticaal: Moves the center up (negative) or down (positive) from the image center.
params.Amplitude: How far the spikes reach; higher values give deeper waves.
params.Frequentie: Number of spikes around the center; higher values give more, narrower spikes.
params.Straal (%): Size of the undistorted area in the middle, as a percentage of half the smaller image side.
params.Randmodus: Decides what fills areas that sample outside the image: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves them clear, and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side.

8287.about: Shifts pixels in different directions based on a map, which gives a warped, rippled or heat haze look.

params.Toewijzing: Own brightness uses the image itself as the map, so the warping follows its shapes; Noise texture uses smooth random noise for an organic distortion.
params.Sterkte: Maximum distance pixels are moved; higher values give stronger warping.
params.Schaal: Size of the map structures; higher values give larger, smoother warps, lower values give finer ones.
params.Randmodus: Decides what fills areas that sample outside the image: Background color uses the current background color, Repeat stretches the edge pixels, Transparent leaves them clear, and Wrap takes pixels from the opposite side.

8090.about: Smears bright parts of the image sideways into streaks of different lengths, as if blown by wind. Good for motion and windswept effects.

params.Windrichting: From left blows the streaks toward the right; From right blows them toward the left.
params.Windsterkte: Higher values give longer streaks that are blended more strongly into the image.
